2609.15611.title: Multi-View Molecular Representation Learning with Hierarchical Graphs and Contextualized Fingerprints
2609.15611.paper_summary: Molecular property prediction requires representations that generalize from limited labeled data to structurally novel compounds. Existing molecular pretraining methods often rely on a single view: graph-based approaches model atom-bond topology but provide limited fragment-level supervision, whereas fingerprint descriptors encode chemical patterns but are typically used as fixed auxiliary features. We propose HiFi-Mol, a multi-view framework that separately pretrains a hierarchical graph encoder and a contextualized fingerprint encoder before downstream integration. The graph branch uses fragment-aware masking with multi-resolution supervision to capture substructure-aware representations, while the fingerprint branch tokenizes active entries from seven fingerprint families and applies masked language modeling to learn contextualized embeddings. During fine-tuning, HiFi-Mol combines projected multi-resolution graph features with fingerprint embeddings for downstream prediction. Evaluated on MoleculeNet benchmarks under the scaffold split, HiFi-Mol achieves a 2.77% improvement in average ROC-AUC over the best baseline across eight classification tasks while maintaining competitive performance on three regression tasks. Further analyses reveal that fragment-aware masking improves graph representation quality, and classification results demonstrate dataset-dependent strengths of the individual graph and fingerprint variants, confirming that the two views provide complementary predictive signals.
2609.15611.paper_summary_zh: 分子性質預測需要能夠從有限的標記數據中推廣到結構上新穎的化合物的表徵。現有的分子預訓練方法通常依賴於單一視角：基於圖的方式建模原子-鍵拓撲，但提供的片段級監督有限，而指紋描述符編碼化學模式，但通常用作固定的輔助特徵。我們提出了HiFi-Mol，一個多視角框架，分別對層次圖編碼器和上下文化指紋編碼器進行預訓練，然後進行下游整合。圖支路使用片段感知掩蔽和多解析度監督來捕捉子結構感知的表徵，而指紋支路則對來自七個指紋家族的活躍條目進行標記，並應用掩蔽語言建模來學習上下文化的嵌入。在微調過程中，HiFi-Mol將投影的多解析度圖特徵與指紋嵌入結合，以進行下游預測。在MoleculeNet基準測試中，根據支架拆分進行評估，HiFi-Mol在八個分類任務中相較於最佳基線實現了平均ROC-AUC提高2.77%的改進，同時在三個回歸任務中保持了競爭力的表現。進一步的分析顯示，片段感知掩蔽提高了圖表徵的質量，而分類結果則展示了個別圖和指紋變體在數據集依賴性上的優勢，確認了這兩個視角提供了互補的預測信號。
